styles.container: max-width: 740px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; font-family: "Comic Sans MS", "Chalkboard SE", "Comic Neue", cursive; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #252a34 !important; background: #7fd1ae !important; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.h1: font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: #252a34; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #7fd1ae; padding-bottom: 10px; margin: 32px 0 16px; position: relative;
styles.h2: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #252a34; background-color: #ff4e79; padding: 4px 10px; transform: rotate(-2deg); margin: 28px 0 14px; border: 3px solid #4db6ac;
styles.h3: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #252a34; background-color: #51bafa; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; margin: 24px 0 12px; transform: rotate(1deg);
styles.h4: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #252a34; line-height: 1.4 !important; margin: 20px 0 10px; border-left: 5px solid #7fd1ae; padding-left: 12px;
styles.h5: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #252a34; line-height: 1.4 !important; margin: 18px 0 9px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #7fd1ae, #7fd1ae 5px, #ff4e79 5px, #ff4e79 10px); padding: 8px;
styles.h6: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #252a34; line-height: 1.4 !important; margin: 16px 0 8px; border: 2px dotted #4db6ac; padding: 6px;
styles.strong: font-weight: 700; color: #252a34; background-color: #fff; padding: 0 5px; border: 3px solid #4db6ac; display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-2deg); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #4db6ac;
styles.em: font-style: italic; color: #ff4e79; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline wavy #51bafa;
styles.a: color: #7fd1ae !important; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 3px solid #4db6ac; padding: 0 3px; transition: all 0.3s ease; background-color: #fff;
styles.ul: margin: 16px 0; padding-left: 24px; background-color: rgba(#7fd1ae22); padding: 15px; border: 2px solid #4db6ac; border-radius: 8px;
styles.ol: margin: 16px 0; padding-left: 24px; counter-reset: item; background-color: rgba(#ff4e7922); padding: 15px; border: 2px dashed #4db6ac; border-radius: 8px;
styles.li: margin: 10px 0; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #252a34 !important; position: relative; padding-left: 25px; font-weight: 600;
styles.blockquote: margin: 20px 0; padding: 15px 20px; background-color: rgba(#7fd1ae22); border-left: 8px solid #7fd1ae; color: #252a34 !important; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; position: relative;
styles.code: font-family: "Comic Sans MS", cursive; background: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #7fd1ae; border: 2px solid #4db6ac; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre: margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background-color: undefined !important; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6 !important; border: 3px solid #4db6ac; box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #4db6ac; color: #fff !important;
styles.hr: margin: 32px 0; border: none; height: 6px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #7fd1ae, #7fd1ae 10px, #ff4e79 10px, #ff4e79 20px); border-radius: 3px;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; max-height: 600px !important; height: auto; display: block; margin: 20px auto; border: 5px solid #4db6ac; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 #7fd1ae; transform: rotate(-1deg);
styles.table: width: 100%; margin: 20px 0; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 5px; font-size: 15px; background: rgba(#7fd1ae22); border: 3px solid #4db6ac; border-radius: 8px;
styles.th: background: linear-gradient(45deg, #7fd1ae, #ff4e79); color: #fff !important; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; border-radius: 4px;
styles.td: padding: 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #4db6ac; color: #252a34 !important; background: #fff; border-radius: 4px;
